description.value:
Your Sharingan is active. While this effect persists, you gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks, AC against melee Strikes (movement-prediction), and saves against visual illusions. You can attempt @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllSpShrnganCpy]{Sharingan: Copy Technique} as a reaction.

Each round the Sharingan is active, take note for chakra-strain bookkeeping: every 10 rounds of continuous activity (1 minute) imposes fatigued for 10 minutes once deactivated.
